notes: Chroma Audio Suite 2026.11.22: ChromaCore v2.9.8 Concert-Pitch & Zero-Ringing DSP Overhaul (fixed 440x audio-rate VCO thermal drift FM buzz, tightened polyphonic chord dispersion for pure A=440.00 Hz Cm9/Abmaj7 tuning, staggered 4-pole ladder damping to eliminate Q^2 hollow 160 Hz ringing, fixed 25 legacy quarter-tone O2Pitch presets to symmetric concert-pitch fine detune, fixed 38 hard-panned legacy presets, fixed Reverb midGainDB boost + quadrature comb modulation, and fixed Cyberpunk Reese serial HP24 sub choke); ChromaVoice v4.0.0 Solar Monolith Orbit; ChromaVerb v3.2.0 Eclipse Sonar.

ChromaCorePro.notes: Unified into ChromaCoreVST v2.9.8: Concert-pitch A=440.00 Hz overhaul, eliminated audio-rate VCO drift ringing, staggered 4-pole ladder damping, fixed 25 out-of-tune + 38 hard-panned legacy presets, plus 2027 4x AA UI, 4-mode visualizer & Circle-of-5ths HARM SEQ.
